claims: The 2026 Masters cut rule dictates that only the top 50 players (plus ties) after Friday's second round advance to the weekend.
As of late Thursday, the 2026 projected cut line is +3.
After R1 of the 2026 Masters, Collin Morikawa is at +2.
After R1 of the 2026 Masters, Matt Fitzpatrick is at +2.
After R1 of the 2026 Masters, Viktor Hovland is at +3.
After R1 of the 2026 Masters, Bryson DeChambeau is at +4.
Before 2020, the top 50 and anyone within 10 strokes of the leader made the Masters cut.
The 10-shot rule is no longer in place for the Masters cut.
